subject: Next steps & architecture review: Labyrinth Health (private deployment)
content:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@labyrinthhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & architecture review: Labyrinth Health (private deployment)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:  

- Summary from call: Labyrinth Health wants a private VPC deployment that keeps PHI in your AWS account, with S3-backed log retention and optional HSM for key management. Key priorities were latency under 150ms P95 for the web triage flow, and clear audit logs for each inference request.
- Open items we flagged: expected token volumes for peak hours, whether the inference workload is bursty vs steady, and any existing internal firewall restrictions that could impact our private control plane egress.

Proposed next step: schedule a 60-minute architecture review / technical deep dive with our solutions engineering team + your infra owners. Suggested slots (Pacific):
  1) Tue 22 Jun, 10:00–11:00 PT
  2) Wed 23 Jun, 14:00–15:00 PT

Agenda (draft, attached):
  - Brief goals & constraints (10m)
  - Network & VPC topology options (20m)
  - Auth/KMS & audit/log pipeline (15m)
  - Rollout plan & fallbacks (10m)
  - Action items / owners (5m)

Attachments: Redwood_Proposed_Arch_Agenda.md (agenda), Labyrinth_MATP_and_DataFlow.pdf (doc you shared during discovery)

Can you confirm which slot works or propose a different time? Also please add the names of the infra/ops people who should join.

Thanks — I’ll get a calendar invite out once we lock the time.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

---

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@labyrinthhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Support Team <support@labyrinthhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps & architecture review: Labyrinth Health (private deployment)

Grace —

Appreciate the clear recap. Wed 23 Jun 14:00–15:00 PT (17:00–18:00 ET) works best for us. I’m looping in our infra lead and security ops aliases in this thread (support@labyrinthhealth.com) — they’ll be the right folks for the deep-dive.

Joining: Jordan Price (me) — Product; joining from infra/security: Taylor Nguyen (infra lead) and Samir Patel (security). I’ll confirm calendar invites for Taylor and Samir shortly.

Two quick notes:
- Peak tokens: expect ~1.3M tokens/day with spikes up to ~50 concurrent requests during morning triage windows.
- We run a managed NAT setup; we may need to open outbound TLS to a Redwood-managed control-plane endpoint. If there are alternatives (e.g., private connector), please flag them for the meeting.

Thanks — see you Wed.
Jordan
Product Lead | Labyrinth Health
jordan.price@labyrinthhealth.com

On Sat, 19 Jun 2027 08:07:00 -0700, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & architecture review: Labyrinth Health (private deployment)

Quick internal note — I’m available Wed 23 Jun 14:00 PT and can cover VPC topology and private control plane options. Monica, can you handle the KMS/HSM + audit/log pipeline segment? I’ll prepare two short diagrams: (1) NAT + Redwood control-plane via egress TLS (if allowed), (2) Private connector via transit VPC.

Also we should confirm whether Labyrinth needs HSM-backed key storage or if KMS with envelope encryption is acceptable for the initial rollout. If they want HSM for all keys we’ll need to scope additional ops runbook items.

I’ll draft the diagrams and drop them in the shared Drive link before the call.

—Karthik
Sr Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@labyrinthhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & architecture review: Labyrinth Health (private deployment)

Perfect — thanks Jordan.

I’ve scheduled the architecture review for Wed, 23 Jun 2027, 14:00–15:00 PT and sent a calendar invite to the attendees (including Taylor & Samir if they accept). The invite includes the draft agenda and the two attachments referenced earlier.

Prep items for our side / ask from Labyrinth before the call:
- One-paragraph description of how you expect requests to be routed from the web app to the inference endpoint (sample request flow).
- Firewall/NAT constraints and whether outbound TLS to a Redwood control-plane host is permitted (or if we should plan for a private connector).
- Confirm whether HSM is required initially or later in the roadmap.

If anything changes on your side, reply-all and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Grace
